description: This PHP class 'ExpenseType' defines an entity for managing expense types within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties like id, name, description, user (who added the expense type), status, and isDeleted. It also uses a trait for decorator behaviors and provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: ExpenseType
classes.description: Entity class representing an expense type with properties and methods for ORM integration and business logic.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the expense type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the expense type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the expense type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the expense type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the expense type, if any.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the expense type.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Gets the user who added/created the expense type.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Assigns a user as the creator of the expense type.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status (active/inactive) of the expense type.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the expense type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the expense type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense type as deleted or not.
